name: Donald Trump
description: Follow Donald Trump, a tracked person, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Trump slams Jeanine Pirro for dropping Reflecting Pool vandalism cases, says she "choked"
changes.summary: "She folded like an umbrella," President Trump said of Jeanine Pirro, U.S. Attorney for the District of Columbia.

changes.title: NATO spending pressure returned
changes.summary: Two holdout Republican senators said they will support acting Attorney General Todd Blanche after he scrapped potential payouts to Trump allies. NBC News’ Gabe Gutierrez reports.

changes.title: An Emerging Deal Between Iran and Oman to Reopen Hormuz Would Come at a Cost for Trump
changes.summary: The deal would address President Trump’s most urgent political problem by allowing ships to move again. But it would give Iran strategic leverage it did not have before the war.

changes.title: Pirro Meets With Trump at the White House After He Said She ‘Choked’ in Reflecting Pool Case
changes.summary: President Trump said Jeanine Pirro, the U.S. attorney for Washington, D.C., “folded like an umbrella.” For now, her job appeared to be safe, according to two people familiar with the meeting.

changes.title: New Limits on Trump’s I.R.S. Deal, and Prosecutors Say Reflecting Pool Work Was ‘Botched’
changes.summary: Plus, why college jerseys suddenly have corporate logos.

changes.title: Oil Prices Plummet as Investors Digest Pause in Iran War Fighting
changes.summary: The markets’ moves were the first since President Trump said he had halted a planned U.S. assault on Iran.

changes.title: Trump’s Meddling in Justice Dept. Causes Problems of His Own Making
changes.summary: In the past week alone, President Trump’s interference has imperiled one criminal case, set the stage for sanctions in a second and hindered the confirmation chances of his pick for attorney general.

changes.title: After Colleges Reject ‘Compact,’ Trump Officials Try a Letter
changes.summary: The open letter from Education Secretary Linda McMahon fell far short of the attempt at a compact last year that dangled research money in return for embracing the Trump administration’s agenda.

changes.title: Documents Undercut Trump’s Claims About Bears Ears National Monument
changes.summary: President Trump said recreation in Bears Ears National Monument was virtually impossible. Documents reviewed by The New York Times show officials knew otherwise.

changes.title: Takeaways after Trump takes questions on Iran, Reflecting Pool in Oval Office
changes.summary: President Trump took reporter questions on the Iran war, the renovation of the reflecting pool in Washington, D.C., and more on Monday. CBS News' Lindsey Reiser and Natalie Brand share their biggest takeaways.
